issue.title: just check fails at lint (symvision): usage refresh split imports private helpers across new modules
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** `just _lint-symvision` (lint stage of `just check`)

Deterministic static-lint failure, not a test and not intermittent: reproduced on the
clean tree (changes stashed) with exit 1, same symbol list twice in a row.

`just _lint-symvision` fails with "Private functions/classes should not be imported"
for helpers that commit 8cc58fb06 ("refactor(usage): split refresh.py into facade plus
five focused modules") now imports across the new modules:

- `_refresh_submit.py` imports `_admit_one`, `_disabled_receipt`, `_normalize_execution`, `_normalize_origin` (and `_provider_*` eligibility helpers from `_refresh_eligibility.py`)
- `_refresh_execution.py` imports `_live_inline_providers`, `_record_inline_crash`, `_release_started`, `_run_inline_batch`, `_runner_payload`, `_submit_started_proc`
- `_refresh_triggers.py` / `_refresh_eligibility.py` cross-import `_mark_usage_refresh_due`, `_provider_cli_ready`, `_provider_has_probe_capability`, `_referenced_provider_ids`, `_resolve_requested_providers`
- `_refresh_model.py` / `_presentation_snapshot.py` surface `_UsageRefreshProviderResult`, `_display_provider_rows`, `_usage_diagnostic_to_json`

Root cause: the split kept `_`-prefixed names while moving them into separate modules.
Fix: make the cross-module helpers public in the new private modules (the modules are
already `_`-prefixed, so public names inside them stay package-internal), or fold
helpers back so each is used only in its defining file. Same pattern as sase-13l,
sase-10n, sase-zk, sase-17j, sase-17c. The presentation-split half of the same output
is sase-17j; the plugins_browser half is sase-17c; this bead is the refresh-split
third. Do not touch finalizers/declaration_manifest.py: its new `_assigned_bead_status`
/ `_host_close_bead_status` helpers are used only in-file and produce no symvision
errors.
